chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Ibn Muskān, from Mālik al-Juhanī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the time of ẓuhr, so he said: When the sun declines, then the time of the two prayers has entered.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose movement marks the prayer time
key_terms.الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the two prayers, meaning ẓuhr and ʿaṣr
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed legal time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr begin according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal beginning of the time of ẓuhr prayer. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains that when the sun passes its zenith, the time for both ẓuhr and ʿaṣr begins, which is significant in discussions of prayer times and their shared period.
